facts.text: The building was designed by Charles Fitzroy Doll in 1898, who also designed the dining room on the Titanic.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Charles Fitzroy Doll in 1898, who also designed the dining room on the Titanic

facts.text: The hotel opened in 1900 under the name Hotel Russell.
facts.excerpt: Opening in 1900 under the name Hotel Russell

facts.text: Hotel Russell was the first hotel in London to have en suite bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: including being the first hotel in London to have en suite bathrooms

facts.text: The hotel occupies the entire eastern side of Russell Square Gardens.
facts.excerpt: this iconic hotel occupies the entire eastern side of Russell Square Gardens

facts.text: The bedrooms were designed by Tara Bernerd & Partners.
facts.excerpt: Each luxuriously styled bedroom, designed by Tara Bernerd & Partners

facts.text: The Bloomsbury Suites sit within the hotel's turrets and have panoramic views of Russell Square.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within our iconic turrets, the Bloomsbury Suites offer a one-of-a-kind stay with breathtaking panoramic views of Russell Square.

facts.text: Fitz's Bar is reached through an unassuming side door.
facts.excerpt: Step through an unassuming side door to uncover the stunning Fitz's Bar.

facts.text: Fitz's Bar has ostrich feathers, Victorian curiosities, a fireplace and a mirrorball.
facts.excerpt: Picture dazzling ostrich feathers, eclectic Victorian curiosities, a roaring fireplace and our shimmering mirrorball.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in the room said to have inspired the Titanic's first-class dining saloon.
facts.excerpt: served in the very room that’s said to have inspired the ship’s first-class dining saloon

facts.text: The Terrace is a seasonal outdoor bar and restaurant inspired by the Italian Riviera.

facts.text: Pets stay at no additional charge and no deposit is required.

facts.text: There is no size or weight limit for pets, and no limit on the number of pets.

facts.text: The fitness centre has Peloton exercise bikes, Technogym cardio machines and free weights.
facts.excerpt: Peloton® exercise bikes, TechnoGym cardio machines, and free weights
